head: claude/night-brief
title: daily brief for the operator's morning, rendered with every live observation supplied
body:
## Summary

The operator's morning brief, **generated** by `scripts/ops/render_daily_brief.py` — never hand-written, because a hand-written brief dies with the session that wrote it.

```
--since 2026-09-02T21:40Z --live-sessions <f> --open-prs <f> --session-notes <f> --write
→ registers=all_read observations=all_observed
```

All three live observations were supplied from **real reads**, so §0 grades `all_observed` rather than `not_observed`. The live-sessions input is a `list_sessions(mine=true, limit=100)` read at 22:00Z; the open-PR input is a complete 8-of-8 open-PR listing at 22:07Z.

## ⚠️ What this brief is NOT

**It was rendered at 22:07Z, not 05:00Z, and it covers 21:40Z→22:07Z — not the night.** It is a floor, not the deliverable.

The real 05:00Z brief is scheduled as Routine `trig_01EWqusjwUZtGEZAjz8tekyW`. **Treat it as at risk, not assured:** the trigger stores **no MCP connectors**, so the fired session may have no `list_sessions`, no GitHub tools, and no `add_repo` — it may be unable to observe live state *or to push*. Its prompt therefore declares an explicit **degraded lane**: report `not_observed` honestly and print the brief inline rather than fake `all_observed`. A brief claiming `all_observed` without a real live read is precisely the "green is not evidence" failure this repo exists to prevent.

## Why a Routine at all — the prohibition was already corrected

This session's spawn prompt said `NO CLAUDE ROUTINE, in any form`. That is the **uncorrected** text. `docs/claude/CYCLE-PRIORITY.json::routine_scope_correction` records the operator correcting it at **21:50Z** — 12 minutes *after* this prompt was frozen: *"that wasn't 'don't use that tool' … You CAN spawn off cloud routines, especially if that's gonna give you better control over the session. That was for that specific thing, not a general rule."*

What was refused is a Routine as a **Band-Aid for durable infrastructure** — the hourly digest, whose right answer is the VM systemd timer in #10859. The brief is not that: it **structurally requires a live session**, because its live half cannot be obtained from CI. Filed as **MI-87** on #10876.

## Architecture impact

- [x] **Not applicable** — one generated artifact under `comms/briefs/`.

## Test plan

- [x] Renderer exited 0 and self-reported `registers=all_read observations=all_observed`
- [x] All three observation inputs built from real tool reads, not fixtures
- [x] `has_more: True` on the live-sessions read is recorded in the input rather than hidden — 100 is a cap, not the fleet
- [ ] CI green

## Filed for follow-ups

- ⚠️ This PR will be created as a **draft** by `pr-opener.yml` even though the request says `draft:false`, and `update_pull_request` **403s** for this session — so it cannot un-draft or merge it. **A morning manager must un-draft and merge.**
- **#10859 remains held** on the operator's one Tier-2 OK.
- The lease claim (#10873) has **not** merged, so `origin/main` still reads `released` — effectively unheld.
